export_rights.summary: Current Asana developer documentation describes a JSON organization export as the complete data of an organization and limits its API to Service Accounts of Enterprise+ organizations. Current Help Center documentation also describes per-project JSON/CSV export, Admin Console domain export, member/team CSV export, audit-log CSV export, and connected-app activity CSV export. These are documented product routes, not a contractual determination of export rights; the customer agreement and DPA were not reviewed.

routes.how: API: POST https://app.asana.com/api/1.0/organization_exports with {data:{organization:<workspace_gid>}}; poll GET /organization_exports/{organization_export_gid} until state=finished; download the gzip JSON file at download_url. UI: profile photo > Admin console > Settings > Domain export; the completion link is emailed to the admin.
requires: Enterprise+ organization and Service Account token for the API route
appropriate admin access for the Admin Console route
routes.rate_limits: API standard limits apply (150 req/min free domains, 1500 req/min paid domains); export endpoints are also limited to 5 concurrent jobs per user.
gotchas: Exports can take from several minutes to a few hours for large organizations.
download_url may be null while in progress or on failure, and when present may only be valid for 1 hour from retrieval — refresh on demand, do not persist.
Docs do not state whether attachment binaries are included in the JSON export.

routes.how: REST API at https://app.asana.com/api/1.0 (e.g. GET /projects/{project_gid}/tasks, GET /workspaces/{workspace_gid}/tasks/search). Auth: personal access token (Bearer) for single-user scripts, OAuth 2.0 for multi-user apps. Paginate with limit + opaque offset tokens (next_page in response).
requires: personal access token or OAuth 2.0 app; any plan
routes.rate_limits: 150 requests/min (free domains) or 1500 requests/min (premium domains) per token; search API limited to 60 req/min; max 50 concurrent reads and 15 concurrent writes; an additional computational cost-based quota; 429 with Retry-After when exceeded.
gotchas: Large unpaginated result sets may be truncated or time out — pagination is required on newer endpoints; docs recommend splitting queries by team/section per the object hierarchy.
Requests rejected with 429 still count against the quota.
Projects with over 1,000 tasks and deeply nested subtasks are called out as pathological cases.

routes.how: Project/Search/My Tasks: open the view, click the title drop-down, hover Export/Print, and choose JSON or CSV where offered. Members: Admin console > Members > Export CSV. Teams: Admin console > Teams > Export CSV. Admin exports are delivered by emailed download link.
requires: view access for project/Search/My Tasks exports
super admin of a paid organization or division admin for team export
gotchas: CSV project exports do not preserve every task behavior or binary attachment; validate JSON and attachment coverage separately.
Large CSV exports may be generated asynchronously and delivered by email.
An export is permission-scoped; private work the exporting identity cannot see may be absent.

routes.how: Admin console > Apps > Manage apps > Connected apps. Inspect each app for permissions and recent usage, then click Export CSV for user-level activity. The CSV is emailed to the exporting admin.
requires: authorized admin with App management access
gotchas: The exported usage window is 90 days, so absence does not prove an annual or seasonal integration unused.
Configuration and permission detail visible on an app page may need a separate evidence capture if the CSV omits it.

routes.how: Enumerate per object: GET /attachments?parent={task|project_brief|comment gid}, then GET /attachments/{attachment_gid} and fetch download_url. Auth: personal access token or OAuth.
routes.rate_limits: Standard API limits (150/1500 req/min; 50 concurrent reads).
gotchas: download_url may only be valid for two minutes from retrieval — fetch and download immediately, never persist URLs.

download_url is null for Box-hosted attachments and for Vimeo-hosted video messages; host field distinguishes asana/dropbox/gdrive/box/vimeo — externally hosted files must be pulled from their own host.
No documented single bulk-download endpoint; must walk tasks/objects to enumerate attachments.

routes.how: API: GET https://app.asana.com/api/1.0/workspaces/{workspace_gid}/audit_log_events with start_at/end_at/event_type/actor filters and pagination; authenticate with a Service Account token. UI snapshot: Admin console > Security > Audit log > Export CSV.
requires: Enterprise+ or legacy Enterprise Service Account, or Enterprise with Compliance Management Add-on
super admin access for the Admin Console CSV route
gotchas: Events are permanently deleted after 90 days — docs recommend continuous ingestion into a SIEM for a permanent record; a one-time exit export only captures the trailing 90 days.
API only captures events from October 8, 2021 onward.
Covers logins, admin-setting changes, membership/access changes, deletions, exports, app authorizations — not a full change history of task content.

preservation_notes.attachments: Per-object via REST API: list attachments per parent, then download each download_url (valid ~2 minutes; null for Box-hosted and Vimeo video-message attachments — retrieve those from the external host). Whether the Enterprise organization export JSON includes attachment binaries is not stated in the consulted docs. An admin-side 'workspace attachment export' is implied by the audit event workspace_attachment_export_started but is otherwise undocumented in consulted sources.
preservation_notes.audit_log: Audit Log API access currently requires Enterprise+, legacy Enterprise, or Enterprise with the Compliance Management Add-on plus a Service Account token. Super admins can also export a CSV snapshot from Admin console > Security > Audit log. Documented retention is 90 days, so continuous ingestion is required for longer history.
preservation_notes.config_artifacts: No dedicated restorable configuration package is documented. Custom fields, templates, forms-related objects and other metadata are readable through the REST API or organization export where supported. Connected-app inventory and 90-day app activity can be exported from Admin console > Apps > Manage apps > Connected apps. None of these routes is documented as a full configuration restore.

notes: Current live Asana developer and Help Center pages were reviewed for organization, project, member, team, connected-app, and audit-log routes. The recipe remains document-derived and unverified against a live tenant. Still unconfirmed: contractual export/return rights and post-termination window; full organization-export object coverage; binary attachment inclusion; a restorable configuration package; and exact SKU availability in the user's tenant.
research_caveats: The customer agreement and DPA were not reviewed, so the documented product routes are not presented as a legal conclusion about export rights or post-termination access.
No live Asana tenant was used; roles, entitlements, asynchronous delivery, field coverage, and attachment behavior require in-tenant verification.
